## VaultKeyProvider class

Key provider that delegates storage to a VaultKeeper SecretBackend.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class VaultKeyProvider implements KeyProvider 
```
**Implements:** [KeyProvider](./core.keyprovider.md)

## Remarks

This adapter bridges attest-it's key provider system with VaultKeeper's backend abstraction. Any VaultKeeper SecretBackend can be used, enabling storage in macOS Keychain, 1Password, YubiKey, or other backends supported by VaultKeeper.
